paper.citation: Xia, F. and Chan, K. C. G. (2023). Identification, Semiparametric Efficiency, and Quadruply Robust Estimation in Mediation Analysis with Treatment-Induced Confounding. Journal of the American Statistical Association 118(542), 1272–1281. DOI: 10.1080/01621459.2021.1990765.
paper.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
paper.source_locator: Author accepted manuscript §4.1, “Binary C and M”, PDF p.17; https://par.nsf.gov/servlets/purl/10300663.

mechanism.name: Binary mediator and induced confounder with Plackett odds-ratio copula

sampling.dependence: IID rows; within-row binary M and C dependent via Plackett copula

assumptions: Conditional Bernoulli margins and Plackett odds ratio fix joint distribution of M and C given A,X

Natural effect interpreted under a structural coupling of potential variables; numeric NDE here depends only on marginal mediator and confounder probabilities because outcome is additive in C,M apart from A interactions

properties.notes: Binary M,C with treatment- and X-dependent Plackett log odds ratio 1-2A+3X, logistic treatment/margins, A*C and A*M outcome interactions.

estimand.name: NDE
estimand.definition: E[Y(1,M(0))-Y(0,M(0))] under the specified binary copula structural model, with C following the treatment in each outcome potential.

truth.expression: E[Y(1,M(0))-Y(0,M(0))] under the specified binary copula structural model, with C following the treatment in each outcome potential.
truth.derivation: Gauss-Hermite integration, independently checked by Simpson integration.

adaptations: Implement Bernoulli Plackett copula by solving the 2x2 cell probability for the exact specified conditional odds ratio.
Derive population NDE by one-dimensional normal integration; paper rounds its numeric truth to 5.50.
Keep original n=1500 as metadata but use n argument for checker; omit estimation-model misspecification trials.
This binary Plackett/Bernoulli structure is a separate DGP family from the same paper’s continuous Gaussian-copula structure.
warnings: No explicit latent-variable metadata or reliably identifiable latent declarations; absence from this list does not prove that no latent variables exist.
